title: Please… Work on your Project! I mean… really…Work!
author: 3xQuest
selftext:
I'm an indie dev, I use AI, and I'm currently working on three projects.  
I've been checking out other AI-assisted projects, and now I understand why AI games get so much hate — and why there's such a huge difference between how big companies and indie studios use AI.  
Big companies generally know how to use it properly.  
But 99% of AI indie projects? Just SLOP.  
And I'm not even talking about AI-generated assets. I'm talking about the games themselves.  
It's literally:  
"CLAUDE, MAKE ME A GAME → PACKAGE IT → PUBLISH IT!"  
Meanwhile, the developer is sitting on the couch watching Santa Barbara. 😂  
People don't hate games just because AI was used to make them. They hate BAD-QUALITY games. And I completely understand why.  
When everyone keeps flooding the market with low-effort garbage, it's only natural that people start turning against indie developers who use AI.  
The problem isn't AI. The problem is people using AI as an excuse to put zero effort into their work.

comments.author: kremas1
comments.body: AI is human behavior multiplier. In SLOP cases it multiplies laziness.
